acceptanceCriteria: Catalog versions can be persisted, loaded, and identified deterministically; the shipped base catalog is not mutated by user extensions.
Extension and override precedence is documented and tested, including duplicate-symbol and conflict cases.
component: Store the canonical Caliper catalog as a versioned durable Referee object.
componentsAffected: Store the canonical Caliper catalog as a versioned durable Referee object.
Support user-defined extensions layered over an immutable base catalog, with documented explicit override precedence and deterministic conflict handling.
notes: Depends on T-0171 for the expanded catalog model. Runtime conversion behavior and Conch commands remain in T-0172 and T-0173.
rationale: Depends on T-0171 for the expanded catalog model. Runtime conversion behavior and Conch commands remain in T-0172 and T-0173.
testSteps: Automated Referee persistence, versioning, extension layering, override precedence, and conflict tests.
